title: Prime-power cardinality from elementwise prime-power torsion
statement: Let $p$ be a prime natural number and let $A$ be a finite group, meaning a finite set [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set] with associative multiplication, an identity $1$, and inverses. Assume that for every $a\in A$ there exists an integer $r\ge0$ with $a^{p^r}=1$. Then there exists an integer $b\ge0$ such that $|A|=p^b$.
